meaning_sources: 사용자 제공 검증된 의미: 8단계 家家戶戶 의미·대본 검수 지시 (2026-10-20)

panels.scene: A village festival is beginning. A child in hanbok sees festive decorations hanging on several traditional Korean houses.
The child and a friend, both in hanbok, look together at the beautifully decorated houses throughout the village.
The friend points toward the village houses, showing the child how every household has prepared festive decorations.
A wide view shows the whole traditional Korean village filled with festival decorations. The child and friend stand smiling in the foreground, enjoying the festive atmosphere.

items.meaning: 집집마다 살림이 넉넉하고, 사람마다 생활에 부족함이 없음.
meaning_sources: 司馬遷, 史記（太史公書）, 商君列傳. 識典古籍 온라인 원문: https://www.shidianguji.com/zh/book/SJwSMQvJLG/chapter/1m8mabehxmsrf ; 확인일 2026-10-21; 확인한 용례: 行之十年，秦民大説，道不拾遺，山無盜賊，家給人足，民勇於公戰，怯於私鬥，鄉邑大治。

story.meaning: 집집마다 살림이 넉넉하고, 사람마다 생활에 부족함이 없음.

panels.dialogue: 우와! 올해는 벼가 정말 잘 익었네!
panels.scene: A child in hanbok admires golden rice fields in a village blessed with a plentiful harvest.
The child stands beside a village granary filled with grain.
Neighbors in hanbok smile as they share food in the village.
A wide view of a prosperous, peaceful village, with happy villagers and the child in hanbok.
